title: ITE Students Eligible for Financial Assistance
what_it_is: ITE Students Eligible for Financial Assistance

sections.label: ITE fees and financial aid
sections.summary: ITE course fees are funded at over 90% subsidy, and in Academic Year 2016 over 70% of ITE students received financial aid or scholarships.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Specifically, Institute of Technical Education (ITE) course fees are funded at over 90% subsidy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE)'s financial assistance schemes are designed to support up to two-thirds of our students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In Academic Year 2016, over 70% of students at ITE received some form of financial aid or scholarships, such as the Community Development Council/Citizens' Consultative Committees Bursary and MOE Bursary.

sections.label: Streamlining ITE bursary assessment
sections.summary: The MOE ComCare Shared Assessment will let ITE students from ComCare families be assessed for Government bursaries without filling up forms twice, starting in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I mentioned in my speech earlier that over 70% of the students receive some form of financial help and this is different from the 90% subsidy that we give to ITE students.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, 70% is very close to our intended coverage of Government bursaries for Singapore Citizens where we would like to cover up to the 66th percentile of households by income.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, we want to not only help the low-income but also the middle income.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: One good example of how we are going to streamline is that we have the MOE ComCare Shared Assessment where the students in ITE whose families are already on ComCare assistance, when they are being assessed for ComCare assistance, we will also look at the eligibility of the students for Government bursaries at ITE, so that they do not have to fill up the form twice or take up the approach again.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In this way, we will be able to streamline the process, make it easier for them.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is expected to take place or to start in the second half of this year.
